description: Several Assembly Democrats plan to petition Gov. Kathy Hochul to roll back the statewide mandate to build all-electric buildings starting next year. The All-Electric Buildings Act was tucked in the state budget in 2023, and bans new gas hookups in new buildings under seven stories starting Jan. 1.

title: Delay All-electric Mandate | Paula for Assembly
